info.title: LyricsDB API
info.description:
LyricsDB is a high-performance open-source lyrics indexing and synchronization platform.

### Features
* **Multi-Platform Resolution**: Cross-references Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, and ISRC.
* **Precision Timed Lyrics**: Word-by-word and syllable-level sync with background vocals and duet roles.
* **Format Engine**: Real-time conversion to TTML, LRC, LRCA2, YRC, QRC, ESLRC, ASS, LYL, LYS, LQE, and compact JSON.
* **Real-Time Streaming**: Server-Sent Events (SSE) tracking extraction lifecycle and timing progress.
* **PostgreSQL Fast Cache**: Sub-millisecond indexed read-through caching with thundering-herd deduplication.
